Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD PST/DV Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Central Selection Board of Constable (CSBC) has released the PST/DV Admit Card for the post of Constable (General Duty Close Cadre). This recruitment was released for 83 posts. Applications for the Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 February 2026 to 05 March 2026. The PST/DV examination is going to be conducted on 12 September 2026. Candidates who have appeared for this exam can download their Bihar Police CSBC Constable GD PST/DV Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 February 2026
  • Last Date : 05 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 June 2026
  • Exam City Details Available : 11 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 18 June 2026
  • Result : 18 August 2026
  • PST/DV Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • PST/DV Admit Card Date : 05 September 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
